summary: {person} can leave testimony on the county budget by phone.
realLife: Montgomery County listed its budget hotline as a way to submit testimony alongside mail and recorded submissions.
gates: A hearing accepts recorded submissions and its testimony period is open.

turns.writesBack: The speakers' list replaces the recorded submission with live testimony.
